narr: A slow-moving, isolated thunderstorm produced locally heavy rainfall of 3 to 5 inches in Champaign County, which resulted in several roads becoming impassable in the city of Champaign.
ev: Locally heavy rainfall of 3 to 4.5 inches resulted in several roads becoming flooded and impassable on the west side of Champaign. Flooded roads included Interstate Drive, Mattis Avenue, Country Fair Drive, and neighborhoods near I-57/I-72 interchange.
